nodes.name: Chelation precipitation of Ru-Mn precursors
nodes.procedure: RuCl3·3H2O (0.5 mmol, 130.71 mg) and MnCl2·4H2O (0.5 mmol, 98.96 mg) were dissolved in ultra-pure water with vigorous stirring. Ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid disodium salt dihydrate (EDTA-2Na) (0.5 mmol, 186.12 mg) was then added to the mixture, which was stirred for 1 h to form a homogeneous solution. Subsequently, an excess amount of anhydrous ethanol was added to the solution under stirring, and the precipitated products were collected by centrifugation and washed multiple times with anhydrous ethanol. The obtained sample, referred to as Ru0.5Mn0.5-EDTA precursors.

nodes.name: One-step oxidation-calcination to hollow Ru0.5Mn0.5O2
nodes.procedure: The Ru0.5Mn0.5-EDTA precursors were heated to 400 °C and held for 2 h at a heating rate of 5 °C min⁻¹ in a muffle furnace. The resulting black solid powder was washed several times with ultra-pure water to remove NaCl impurities and was denoted as Ru0.5Mn0.5O2 with hollow shell structure.

nodes.name: Pure RuO2 and MnO2 by similar method
nodes.procedure: Pure Ru oxide (Ru1Mn0O2) and pure Mn oxide (Ru0Mn1O2) using a similar chelation precipitation method combined with one-step oxidation process as Ru0.5Mn0.5O2.
nodes.source_text: For comparison, we also synthesized pure Ru oxide (Ru1Mn0O2) and pure Mn oxide (Ru0Mn1O2) using a similar method.

nodes.name: Variable composition Ru-Mn oxides
nodes.procedure: The preparation of the Ru_y Mn1−y O2 (y = 0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.7, 0.9, and 1) followed the same procedure as for Ru0.5Mn0.5O2, except for the adjustment in the amounts of RuCl3·3H2O and MnCl2·4H2O. Specifically, the total amount of Ru and Mn was kept constant at 0.1 M, with the molar ratio of Ru to Mn set as y:(1−y).

nodes.characterization_summary: Dissolved Ru <2 ppm over 50 h OER; Mn rapidly increases to 31.69 ppb in first 2 h then plateaus at 32.33 ppb after 10 h.
